instruction: ship as is, this is good enough
note: The owner accepted the bar for this run only, after five panel rounds moved the median 6.56 -> 7.21 -> 7.38 -> 7.47 with zero hard blockers outstanding at the time of release. This file records their decision; it does not disable any other check. The bytes still have to be the graded bytes, the evidence still has to come from those bytes, and there still have to be three judges. It is bound to 2026-08-08 and applies to no other day.
what_the_owner_was_told: That the median was 7.47 against a 7.5 standing bar, that one judge scored it 7.52 and voted to ship, and that a factual defect on the statute card (row labels asserted as federal statutory categories that the claim record does not carry) was still being repaired when the release was given.
